title: Overhaul of the UH-60 POWER TURBINE MODULE
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.AMC.ACC.ACC-CTRS.ACC RSA.W6QK ACC-RSA
detail_text: The purpose of this amendment 0002 is to extend the solicitation closing date. 1. The closing date is extended from 06 March 2026 to 30 April 2026. 2. This extension is necessary to allow the Government time to review the commerciality of the stated requirement in response to industry feedback. The Government has submitted a request for a Commercial Item Determination (CID) to the Defense Contract Management Agency (DCMA). DCMA has indicated that a current backlog of actions is contributing to delays in processing CID requests. 3. Once the review is complete, the Government will assess if any changes to the solicitation's terms, conditions, or provisions are necessary. If required, the Government will issue another amendment to incorporate those changes. 4. All other terms and conditions of the solicitation remain unchanged at this time.
